scope: Build existing application, inspect development configuration and record user-reported execution/initialization observations; no new application implementation or full-controller functional validation.

checks.name: Clean source build with no reused object files
checks.evidence: Fresh temporary project, no build directory initially; make -j4 all exited 0. See build.log.

checks.name: ELF HEX and BIN produced
checks.evidence: All three files exist and are nonempty.

checks.name: ARM ELF header and startup-vector consistency
VS Code task and extension recommendation JSON
checks.evidence: Valid JSON; default task make -j4 all; Wokwi extension recommended. No editor execution implied.

checks.name: Wokwi configuration syntax and declared circuit structure
checks.evidence: Valid TOML/JSON; correct board identifier, 16 unique component IDs and known endpoint components. Tilt uses the PB0.1 diagram label; actual pin-model mapping and electrical behaviour remain unverified.

checks.name: Application and vendor source preservation
checks.evidence: 90 C/header/startup files match the snapshot; no Core or Drivers changes.

checks.name: Observed VS Code task execution
checks.reason: VS Code executable is not installed in the cloud executor; equivalent terminal build was run.

checks.name: Observed Wokwi firmware execution
checks.evidence: User supplied repeated Wokwi firmware diagnostic records; see wokwi-observation.txt. This confirms execution, not successful sensor initialization.

checks.name: Sensor initialization observation
checks.evidence: Initial record: sensor wake write failed; who=0x68 reg=0x6B bus=GPIO hwerr=0x20 split=4 serr=0. Later records: I2C recovery failed.
checks.diagnostic_limit: First-failure HW snapshot belongs to the earlier read timeout. Current write wait flag and original write HAL return are not preserved in the displayed record.
checks.follow_up: Peripheral/sensor verification; capture wake-write state before fallback before selecting a code change.

limitations: Existing application is a full controller, not a minimal newly written Stage 2 application.
Sensor initialization fails at the wake write; acceleration measurements and actuator/FSM operation remain unverified.
Wokwi execution evidence is user-supplied; exact running firmware hash was not independently checked.
VS Code build-task execution remains NOT_RUN; the equivalent clean terminal build passed.
Static RAM allocation does not measure runtime stack growth.
Tilt diagram pin PB0.1 needs simulator pin-model validation in the peripheral stage.
Course AI restrictions and missing rubric remain as recorded in Stage 1.

observation.summary: Firmware execution confirmed; identity read returned 0x68 through the separate-read path, then wake-register write and GPIO recovery failed.
